ICS: Example of consult question from student: “This is a 58 year old man with CAD and alcoholic cirrhosis admitted for hepatic encephalopathy, due to stopping his lactulose. I am now concerned about a large GI bleed due to a rapid drop in his hemoglobin since admission to 8.2 from baseline of 13.4, new melanic stools (most recently ½ hour ago), and patient becoming more hypotensive/symptomatic. I am requesting an emergent EGD to evaluate for source of bleeding. He has already received 2L IVF, PPI drip, octreotide, ceftriaxone, blood is ordered. He has 2 large bore IVs in place. Can you see him now?”
